correctness.rationale: The published torus basis consists of the unit, \(w\), and the loop-basis elements \((k,l)_Y\). In even order \(n\), Theorem 5.6 maps \(w\) to zero, the unit to itself, and \((k,l)_Y\) to \((nk,nl)_Y\). Lattice multiplication by \(n\) is injective, so the non-\(w\) images are distinct target-basis elements. Linear independence therefore forces every kernel vector to be a scalar multiple of w.

evidence: Theorem 5.6 gives the exact images of every basis type.
Corollaries 1.4 and 5.7 conclude only noninjectivity for even order and injectivity for odd order.
